id: W:mayeur|histoire de lenseignement et de leducation
original_title: Histoire générale de l'enseignement et de l'éducation en France. Tome III, De la Révolution à l'école républicaine, 1789-1930
note: Shortened citation to Mayeur’s volume III, reissued by Perrin in 2004; none of the candidates is this book. ISBN identifies the cited reissue.

original_title: Paysans de l'Ouest : des structures économiques et sociales aux options politiques depuis l'époque révolutionnaire dans la Sarthe
note: Paul Bois’s 1960 study, first published at Le Mans by Vilaire. No candidates. Confirmed OCLC identifies the later 1978 Flammarion edition, not the 1960 printing.

The supposed title is only a publication place, publisher and date. The attribution to Julio Lucchesi Moraes does not identify a 1990 Ática book; no reliable reconstruction or identifier can be assigned from this fragment.

id: W:levi strauss|as estruturas elementares do parentesco
original_title: Les structures élémentaires de la parenté
note: Portuguese translation of the French book; prefer the 1949 original over the English translation candidate.

original_title: Le chagrin et le venin : la France sous l'Occupation, mémoire et idées reçues
note: Same 2011 Bayard book; minor subtitle variation (mémoires/mémoire).

original_title: Lieux de savoir. Volume 1, Espaces et communautés
note: The cited subtitle identifies the first volume of the collective work edited by Christian Jacob; the candidate gives its shorter collective title.

original_title: A Casa de Bragança, 1560-1640 : práticas senhoriais e redes clientelares
note: Shortened title of the 2000 book, distinct from Cunha’s 1990 study of 1384-1483.
Boitempo’s 2011 translation explicitly uses the 1955 Aufbau German edition. Parts had appeared in Russian in 1937-38; 1955 is the German book edition. Prefer it over the English translation.

id: W:borges|doutrina de seguranca nacional e os governos militares
original_title: A Doutrina de Segurança Nacional e os governos militares
container: Jorge Ferreira and Lucilia de Almeida Neves Delgado (eds.), O Brasil Republicano, vol. 4: O tempo da ditadura: regime militar e movimentos sociais em fins do século XX. Rio de Janeiro: Civilização Brasileira, 2003, pp. 13-42.
note: Chapter by Nilson Borges, not a standalone book. OCLC identifies the containing volume; page range is corroborated by the UFPB publisher’s Ecos da ditadura militar no Brasil profundo bibliography. No DOI confirmed.
Portuguese translation of Regarding the Pain of Others, not On Photography.

First published by Difusão Européia do Livro in 1961, with Pedro Moacyr Campos and Emília Viotti da Costa; based on Glénisson’s teaching in Brazil. UFRJ catalogues the 1961 edition. No LCCN, ISBN or OCLC could be verified; identifier fields are deliberately empty.

original_title: A Poetics of Postmodernism: History, Theory, Fiction
note: UEL’s catalogue explicitly identifies the 1991 Ricardo Cruz translation as A Poetics of Postmodernism; distinct from The Politics of Postmodernism.

original_title: Presença dos Estados Unidos no Brasil : (dois séculos de história)
note: Title has been replaced by an imprint. A plausible reconstruction is the 1978 edition of Presença dos Estados Unidos no Brasil (candidate w-1169799), but O Governo João Goulart also had a 1978 edition. The imprint alone cannot establish either; no work assigned.

id: W:keynes|teoria geral do emprego do juro e da moeda
original_title: The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money
note: Portuguese edition of the 1936 General Theory; the 1996 date is the Nova Cultural edition, not a separate work.
Portuguese translation published by Jorge Zahar in 2000 of the 1999 English book.
Paulo César de Souza’s translation, first issued in 2001, of Die fröhliche Wissenschaft (1882, expanded 1887). The later expanded edition belongs to the same work; prefer the 1882 original.

Brazilian two-volume selection organized by Carlos Nelson Coutinho, Luiz Sérgio Henriques and Marco Aurélio Nogueira (1910-1920; 1921-1926). ISBN is volume 1. Identical contents with Spriano’s Scritti politici, Écrits politiques or the English selections are not established; do not match on the generic title.

Author entity is wrong: this is José Ferrater Mora’s dictionary, not a work by José María Luis Mora. First Spanish edition: Atlante, Mexico, 1941. ISBN confirmed in Loyola’s publisher catalogue identifies Portuguese tome 1; no candidate is the dictionary.
Luigi Del Re’s Portuguese translation, Rocco, 1988. UFSC’s bibliographic record confirms the ISBN and identifies the Italian original, Francesco De Silva, 1947. No candidates.

Exact article already represented by the candidate, whose kind is recorded as other. Published in Portuguese in 1989, translated by Dora Rocha Flaksman; no separate earlier French publication established.
